problem: Neighborhoods often have shared tool libraries or community tool sheds, but coordinating reservations, availability, and maintenance is done manually via paper logs or group chats, leading to conflicts and under‑use.
solution: A lightweight, mobile‑responsive static web app that lets residents view, reserve, and return tools in a community shed. All data is stored locally per user and can be exported/imported as JSON for the caretaker, eliminating the need for a server.
target_customers: Residents of housing societies with shared tool sheds

competitors.name: Nextdoor
competitors.difference: General neighborhood social platform, no dedicated tool reservation UI

competitors.name: ShareTool
competitors.difference: Requires cloud subscription and user accounts; our app runs entirely on static hosting

features: View list of tools with availability status
Reserve a tool for a specific date range
Export and import full inventory JSON for caretaker backup
Responsive design for phones and tablets

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Charge a small annual fee (e.g., $5) for premium features like multi‑user sync via Google Drive or automated email reminders
monetization.free_tier: All core reservation features, export/import, unlimited tools

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free‑tier limits
launch_strategy: Create a simple landing page on the repo with a QR code for local community newsletters
Reach out to 3 housing societies via email to pilot the tool and gather feedback

marketing_content.tagline: Reserve, use, return – keep your community tools in sync.
marketing_content.social_post: 🚀 Introducing ToolShare Scheduler – a free, no‑login web app that lets your neighborhood book and track shared tools. No server, no fees, just a simple spreadsheet‑style UI that works on any phone. Try it today at https://yourusername.github.io/toolshare-scheduler

tests: Open the site, click 'Add New Tool', fill name and quantity, save – the tool appears in the list.
Reserve a tool for tomorrow, close the browser, reopen – reservation persists via localStorage.
Mark the tool as returned – status changes back to 'Available'.
next_improvements: Add optional Google Drive sync for multi‑device backup
Implement email reminder notifications via a serverless function
Provide a printable QR code label generator for each tool
